mapper.select: select e.extension_id, e.extension_key, e.extension_name, e.extension_type, e.status, e.description, v.version_id, v.version_no, v.implementation_key, v.checksum, coalesce(e.update_time, e.create_time) as effective_update_time from wf_bpmn_extension e left join wf_bpmn_extension_version v on v.extension_id = e.extension_id and v.version_no = ( select max(latest.version_no) from wf_bpmn_extension_version latest where latest.extension_id = e.extension_id ) order by e.extension_name, e.extension_key
mapper.sql: select e.extension_id, e.extension_key, e.extension_name, e.extension_type, v.version_id, v.version_no, v.implementation_key, v.config_schema, v.checksum from wf_bpmn_extension e inner join wf_bpmn_extension_version v on v.extension_id = e.extension_id inner join ( select extension_id, max(version_no) as version_no from wf_bpmn_extension_version group by extension_id ) latest on latest.extension_id = v.extension_id and latest.version_no = v.version_no where e.status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.select: and e.extension_type = #{extensionType} order by e.extension_name, e.extension_key
select extension_id, extension_key, extension_name, extension_type, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_extension where extension_key = #{extensionKey}

select extension_id, extension_key, extension_name, extension_type, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_extension where extension_key = #{extensionKey} for update

select extension_id, extension_key, extension_name, extension_type, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_extension where extension_id = #{extensionId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into wf_bpmn_extension (extension_key, extension_name, extension_type, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{extension.extensionKey}, #{extension.extensionName}, #{extension.extensionType}, #{extension.status}, #{extension.remark}, #{extension.createBy}, current_timestamp(3), '', null)

insert into wf_bpmn_extension_version (extension_id, version_no, implementation_key, config_schema, checksum, create_by, create_time) values (#{version.extensionId}, #{version.versionNo}, #{version.implementationKey}, #{version.configSchema}, #{version.checksum}, #{version.createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select count(*) from wf_deploy_extension_snapshot s inner join wf_bpmn_extension_version v on v.version_id = s.extension_version_id where v.extension_id = #{extensionId}
